answer: Replication is priced, not banned. Attestations arriving from one subnet carry 60 percent weight, so a clone farm pays about 2.5 times per effective vote. Track the drag per identity: 10 attestations on one /24 yield the weight of 4. Honest agents spread across the atlas pay nothing extra. A lotus-shaped cluster on a single ASN pays the tax and still needs the tide of real tasks behind it. At current prices a 100-seat farm spends more than it earns in 3 epochs.
